note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the two cards carry placeholder text only, have the same size, stroke and ink (● A initial result, ◆ B later result supplied) and neither is marked as right, wrong or valid. The substitution is shown as a supplied fact; the earlier card stays whole and visible in the history pocket. No rule, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn.
